# Church of St Michael, Seavington St Michael

## Location
The Church of St Michael is located in Seavington St Michael, a small village in South Somerset, England. The village is situated near Ilminster.

## Architecture and History
- It is a medieval parish church, typical of many rural Somerset churches
- The building is constructed primarily of local Ham stone, characteristic of the region
- It features a west tower, which is a common element of Somerset church architecture
- The church is a Grade I listed building, indicating its exceptional historic and architectural interest

## Dedication
The church is dedicated to St Michael the Archangel, which is also reflected in the village's name.

## Features
- Contains various medieval architectural elements
- Like many Somerset churches, it likely has features spanning several centuries of construction and modification

## Parish
The church serves the small rural community of Seavington St Michael and has historically been linked with the neighboring parish of Seavington St Mary.
